work.title: In Festo Michaelis: Concerto
Der Engel des Herrn lagert sich
Cantate: In Festo Michaelis

history.p: The cantata, which was composed while Scheibe was still in Leipzig, is one of the few that seems to have been preserved. According to the dates in the manuscript, it was performed at least twice at Neukirche by the church organist Carl Gotthelf Gerlach who is also the copyist of the score: in September 1732 and in September 1757. When Gerlach died in 1761, the cantata was acquired by Breitkopf together with a large number of other works and listed in the publisher’s sales catalogue of that year; however, it is not found in later sales catalogues perhaps due to the declining popularity of church cantatas, but it appears again in Breitkopf’s final auction catalogue of 1836 when the manuscript was bought by the music collector Carl Ferdinand Becker in Leipzig. However, the part material has not survived.

titlePage.p: Festo Michaelis Concerto a 3 Tromb: Tympano 2 Flaut: travers. 2 Oboes 2 Violini | Viola 4 Voc: Con Continuo di Scheibe. | 1732 <57!> [stamped: 'STADTBIBLIOTHEK ZU LEIPZIG' and 'C. F. BECKERS STIFTUNG]

physDesc.physMedium: In 2o; upright format, consisting of four nested bifolios of which fols. 1r–8r are numbered 1–15 in pencil (library); front flyleaf, music (fols. 1r–8r), page with staves but not used (fol. 8v), end flyleaf. Hand-ruled paper, 25 staves on fols. 1r, 4r–v, 7r, 26 staves on fols. 3v, 5r–v, 7v, 8v, 27 staves on fols. 1v, 6r–v, 8r, and 28 staves on fol. 2r–v (7 mm; single rastrum, or possibly a two-stave rastrum, used) in brown ink and music in black ink. Source contains numerous changes, corrections and additions in ink.

A newer half-binding in marbled paper with canvas corners and spine, modern flyleaves, label pasted on front cover: 'Johan Adolf Scheibe | Cantata a festo Michaeli | "Der Engel des Herrn... ["] | a 4 voci con stromenti | (comp. 1732) Partitur Copie | C. F. Becker (1836)'; shelf mark pasted at top left-hand corner ('III, 2, 159'). Pages trimmed before binding. Possibly an earlier label pasted on p. 15 has been removed (cf. SchW C1:007).
